name: Testifly
summary: Autonomous AI QA that discovers your web app's flows from a URL and keeps end-to-end tests running.
description: Testifly crawls a web app from its URL and logins, discovers features, creates end-to-end tests and adapts them when the UI changes, with a coverage map, CI/CD API and integrations (Jira, Linear, Notion, Slack on Growth+). 30-day free trial without card; Starter $29/month, Growth $89, Business $249, Enterprise custom.
